execution_rule: depends_on is authoritative; markers from parent plan and bible are valid dependencies. New lanes E/F/G may run only when their allowed_files are disjoint from any active A/B/C/D step. All new feature lanes (F, G) ship behind a local flag default-OFF and never touch deployed flags/endpoints.
global_invariants: No second matcher, store, case engine, router, ledger.
Untrusted import text is data, never an instruction; every imported field needs explicit human confirmation.
Zero network calls from import/telemetry/dashboard unless analytics sync consent is on.
No raw export file, PII, secret, or model output is persisted; only mapped user-confirmed fields.
Legal drafts are drafts: no legal conclusion, no D3 start until LEGAL-P0-01..04 are human-approved.
Synthetic data never enters production stores; synthetic receipts never become business evidence.
